About Us

At Tint Tone and Shade, we understand that your home is more than just a space—it's a reflection of who you are and the life you want to live. Recognized as one of the best interior designers offering services in Chennai and Hyderabad, we specialize in crafting luxurious, tailor-made interiors that are 100% customised to suit your lifestyle and preferences. Our approach ensures no space is wasted, blending beauty and practicality seamlessly. We are known for our expertise and reliability and we take pride in delivering stress-free, end-to-end interior design solutions that transform every corner of your home into a personalized sanctuary. With a deep commitment to quality and fine craftsmanship, we create spaces that not only look stunning but also feel uniquely yours—spaces where memories are cherished and dreams come to life.

What We Do

Interior Design Services

View All Services

Residential Interior Design

Tailored design services for private homes, including room makeovers and complete home transformations.

Space Planning

Optimizing the layout of a space to improve functionality and flow.

Design Consultation

Providing professional advice on concepts, color schemes & material selection.

Lighting Design

Crafting lighting solutions that enhance the ambiance and functionality of a space.

Custom Furniture Design

Designing and creating bespoke furniture pieces that perfectly fit the your space and style.

Art and Accessory Procurement

Sourcing and selecting art pieces and accessories to complement the overall design.

Color Consultation

Assisting clients in selecting color schemes that enhance the mood and aesthetic of a space.

Renovation and Remodeling

Overhauling existing spaces to modernize and improve functionality and aesthetics.

Project Management

Overseeing all aspects of a design project to ensure it is completed on time, within budget, and to the client’s satisfaction.

Styling and Staging

Arranging furniture and decor to create a cohesive and aesthetically pleasing space, often for real estate showings or final project touches.

DUBAI INTERIORS

Explore Dubai Interiors →

Bringing Luxury Interior Design to Dubai

At Tint Tone & Shade, we create sophisticated interiors for modern Dubai living. From elegant apartments to premium villas, our designs combine functionality, comfort, and timeless aesthetics tailored to your lifestyle.

Our Dubai interior design services focus on creating refined spaces with smart planning, premium finishes, customized furniture, lighting concepts, and detail-driven execution. Every project is designed to reflect contemporary luxury while maintaining warmth and practicality for everyday living.

Whether you are designing a new home or upgrading your existing space, our team delivers personalized interior solutions crafted with creativity, precision, and attention to detail.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Your questions, our answers

What services does Tint Tone and Shade offer?

We offer residential interior design, modular kitchen designs, lighting solutions, custom furniture, space planning, design consultations, and more.

What is your approach to customization?

We specialize in fully personalized designs tailored to your unique space and style, ensuring both functionality and aesthetic harmony.

Do you provide project management?

Yes, we manage every aspect, from the initial concept to final execution, ensuring a stress-free experience for you.

What after-sales support do you provide?

We offer two free service visits within six months post-completion and long-term maintenance support at a nominal fee. Additionally, we provide a 10-year warranty on modular kitchens.

Do you assist with material selection?

Absolutely, our designers accompany you for material selection to ensure choices align perfectly with your design vision and budget.

What makes Tint Tone and Shade unique?

Our team delivers fully customized solutions, high-quality craftsmanship, seamless project management, and comprehensive after-sales care, setting us apart.

Do modular kitchens include warranties?

Yes, our modular kitchens come with a 10-year warranty on materials and workmanship, ensuring durability and peace of mind.

Why hire a professional interior designer?

Professional interior designers bring expertise, creative solutions, and project management skills to deliver cohesive, stunning spaces aligned with your budget and style.
